items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Doug Ramsey has suggested that one of the influences on the octet was Stravinsky’s Octet... [INTERVIEWER] Doug Ramsey’s book.

ctx.x: Yeah. I don’t like it too much.
Let me ask you about another composer. Doug Ramsey has suggested that one of the influences on the octet was Stravinsky’s Octet that he composed in 1923. Was that a work that influenced you?
Not me. It could have been Bill Smith. Bill probably knew it.
